source_units.display_text: The Lord Sabaoth planned it, to dissolve all the insolence of the glorious and dishonor everything glorious upon the earth.

source_units.text: Work your land, for ships no longer come from Carthage.
source_units.display_text: Work your land, for ships no longer come from Carthage.

source_units.text: Your hand no longer has strength at sea, the hand that provoked kings. The Lord Sabaoth commanded concerning Canaan, to destroy her strength.
source_units.display_text: Your hand no longer has strength at sea, the hand that provoked kings. The Lord Sabaoth commanded concerning Canaan, to destroy her strength.

source_units.text: They will say, “You shall no longer continue in insolence and in wronging Sidon’s daughter.” Even if you go to the Kitians, there too you will have no rest,
source_units.display_text: They will say, “You shall no longer continue in insolence and in wronging Sidon’s daughter.” Even if you go to the Kitians, there too you will have no rest,

source_units.text: and into the Chaldeans’ land: this too has been devastated by the Assyrians. There too you will have no rest, because her wall has fallen.
source_units.display_text: and into the Chaldeans’ land: this too has been devastated by the Assyrians. There too you will have no rest, because her wall has fallen.

source_units.text: Wail, ships of Carthage, because your fortress has perished!
source_units.display_text: Wail, ships of Carthage, because your fortress has perished!

source_units.text: On that day Tyre will be left for seventy years, like a king’s time, like a person’s time. After seventy years, Tyre will be like a prostitute’s song:
source_units.display_text: On that day Tyre will be left for seventy years, like a king’s time, like a person’s time. After seventy years, Tyre will be like a prostitute’s song:

source_units.text: “Take a lyre, wander through cities, forgotten prostitute! Play the lyre well, sing much, so that you may be remembered.”
source_units.display_text: “Take a lyre, wander through cities, forgotten prostitute! Play the lyre well, sing much, so that you may be remembered.”

source_units.text: After seventy years God will visit Tyre, and she will again be restored to her former state and become a trading center for all the inhabited world’s kingdoms.
source_units.display_text: After seventy years God will visit Tyre, and she will again be restored to her former state and become a trading center for all the inhabited world’s kingdoms.

source_units.text: Her trade and her wage will be holy to the Lord. It will not be collected for them; instead, all her trade will be for those dwelling before the Lord, to eat and drink and be filled, as a contribution, a memorial before the Lord.
source_units.display_text: Her trade and her wage will be holy to the Lord. It will not be collected for them; instead, all her trade will be for those dwelling before the Lord, to eat and drink and be filled, as a contribution, a memorial before the Lord.

source_units.text: Behold, the Lord is destroying the inhabited world; He will make it desolate, uncover its face and scatter those dwelling in it.
source_units.display_text: Behold, the Lord is destroying the inhabited world; He will make it desolate, uncover its face and scatter those dwelling in it.

source_units.text: The people will be like the priest, the slave like the master, the maidservant like the mistress; the buyer will be like the seller, the lender like the borrower, and the debtor like the one to whom he owes a debt.
source_units.display_text: The people will be like the priest, the slave like the master, the maidservant like the mistress; the buyer will be like the seller, the lender like the borrower, and the debtor like the one to whom he owes a debt.

source_units.text: The earth will be utterly destroyed, and the earth utterly plundered, for the Lord’s mouth has spoken these things.
source_units.display_text: The earth will be utterly destroyed, and the earth utterly plundered, for the Lord’s mouth has spoken these things.

source_units.text: The earth mourned, the inhabited world was destroyed, and the earth’s high ones mourned.
source_units.display_text: The earth mourned, the inhabited world was destroyed, and the earth’s high ones mourned.

source_units.text: The earth acted lawlessly because of those dwelling in it, because they transgressed the law and changed the ordinances, an everlasting covenant.
source_units.display_text: The earth acted lawlessly because of those dwelling in it, because they transgressed the law and changed the ordinances, an everlasting covenant.

source_units.text: Therefore a curse will consume the earth, because those dwelling in it sinned. Therefore those dwelling on the earth will be poor, and few people will be left.
source_units.display_text: Therefore a curse will consume the earth, because those dwelling in it sinned. Therefore those dwelling on the earth will be poor, and few people will be left.

source_units.text: Wine will mourn, the vine will mourn, and all who gladden the soul will groan.
source_units.display_text: Wine will mourn, the vine will mourn, and all who gladden the soul will groan.

source_units.text: The joy of tambourines has ceased; the impudence and wealth of the ungodly have ceased; the lyre’s sound has ceased.
source_units.display_text: The joy of tambourines has ceased; the impudence and wealth of the ungodly have ceased; the lyre’s sound has ceased.

source_units.text: They were ashamed and did not drink wine; sikera became bitter to those drinking it.
source_units.display_text: They were ashamed and did not drink wine; sikera became bitter to those drinking it.

source_units.text: Every city was deserted; he will shut a house so that none may enter.
source_units.display_text: Every city was deserted; he will shut a house so that none may enter.

source_units.text: Wail over wine everywhere! All the earth’s gladness has ceased.
source_units.display_text: Wail over wine everywhere! All the earth’s gladness has ceased.

source_units.text: Cities will be left deserted, and abandoned houses will perish.
source_units.display_text: Cities will be left deserted, and abandoned houses will perish.

source_units.text: All these things will happen on the earth, among the nations: as when someone gleans an olive tree, so they will glean them, even when the grape harvest has ceased.
source_units.display_text: All these things will happen on the earth, among the nations: as when someone gleans an olive tree, so they will glean them, even when the grape harvest has ceased.

source_units.text: These will cry aloud, and those left upon the earth will rejoice together with the Lord’s glory. The sea’s water will be troubled;
source_units.display_text: These will cry aloud, and those left upon the earth will rejoice together with the Lord’s glory. The sea’s water will be troubled;

source_units.text: therefore the Lord’s glory will be in the sea’s islands; the Lord’s name will be glorious—O Lord, Israel’s God!
source_units.display_text: therefore the Lord’s glory will be in the sea’s islands; the Lord’s name will be glorious—O Lord, Israel’s God!

source_units.text: From the earth’s wings we heard wonders: “Hope for the devout!” And they will say, “Woe to those who reject, those who reject the law!”
source_units.display_text: From the earth’s wings we heard wonders: “Hope for the devout!” And they will say, “Woe to those who reject, those who reject the law!”

source_units.text: Fear, pit and trap are upon you who dwell on the earth!
source_units.display_text: Fear, pit and trap are upon you who dwell on the earth!

source_units.text: Whoever flees the fear will fall into the pit, and whoever climbs from the pit will be caught by the trap, because windows from heaven have opened and the earth’s foundations will be shaken.
source_units.display_text: Whoever flees the fear will fall into the pit, and whoever climbs from the pit will be caught by the trap, because windows from heaven have opened and the earth’s foundations will be shaken.

source_units.text: The earth will be utterly agitated, and the earth will be utterly at a loss;
source_units.display_text: The earth will be utterly agitated, and the earth will be utterly at a loss;

source_units.text: The earth has tilted and will be shaken like a fruit-watcher’s shelter, like someone drunk and hungover. It will fall and will never be able to rise, for lawlessness has prevailed upon it.
source_units.display_text: The earth has tilted and will be shaken like a fruit-watcher’s shelter, like someone drunk and hungover. It will fall and will never be able to rise, for lawlessness has prevailed upon it.

source_units.text: God will bring His hand against heaven’s array and against the earth’s kings.
source_units.display_text: God will bring His hand against heaven’s array and against the earth’s kings.

source_units.text: They will gather and shut them into a fortress and a prison; after many generations there will be a visitation of them.
source_units.display_text: They will gather and shut them into a fortress and a prison; after many generations there will be a visitation of them.

source_units.text: The brick will melt and the wall will fall, because the Lord will reign in Zion and in Jerusalem and will be glorified before the elders.
source_units.display_text: The brick will melt and the wall will fall, because the Lord will reign in Zion and in Jerusalem and will be glorified before the elders.

source_units.text: Lord my God, I will glorify Thee and sing Thy name, because Thou hast done wondrous things, an ancient, true plan. May it be so, Lord!
source_units.display_text: Lord my God, I will glorify Thee and sing Thy name, because Thou hast done wondrous things, an ancient, true plan. May it be so, Lord!

source_units.text: For Thou hast made cities a mound, fortified cities so that their foundations fall. The city of the ungodly will certainly never be rebuilt.
source_units.display_text: For Thou hast made cities a mound, fortified cities so that their foundations fall. The city of the ungodly will certainly never be rebuilt.

source_units.text: Therefore the poor people will bless Thee, and cities of wronged people will bless Thee.
source_units.display_text: Therefore the poor people will bless Thee, and cities of wronged people will bless Thee.

source_units.text: For Thou didst become a helper to every lowly city and a shelter to those discouraged by need. Thou wilt rescue them from evil people, a shelter for the thirsty and a breath for wronged people.
source_units.display_text: For Thou didst become a helper to every lowly city and a shelter to those discouraged by need. Thou wilt rescue them from evil people, a shelter for the thirsty and a breath for wronged people.

source_units.text: They will bless Thee like fainthearted people thirsting in Zion because of ungodly people, to whom Thou didst hand us over.
source_units.display_text: They will bless Thee like fainthearted people thirsting in Zion because of ungodly people, to whom Thou didst hand us over.

source_units.text: The Lord Sabaoth will act for all the nations upon this mountain. They will drink gladness, drink wine and anoint themselves with perfume.
source_units.display_text: The Lord Sabaoth will act for all the nations upon this mountain. They will drink gladness, drink wine and anoint themselves with perfume.

source_units.text: On this mountain, hand all these things over to the nations, for this plan concerns all the nations.
source_units.display_text: On this mountain, hand all these things over to the nations, for this plan concerns all the nations.

source_units.text: Death swallowed, having prevailed; and again God removed every tear from every face. He removed the people’s reproach from all the earth, for the Lord’s mouth has spoken.
source_units.display_text: Death swallowed, having prevailed; and again God removed every tear from every face. He removed the people’s reproach from all the earth, for the Lord’s mouth has spoken.

source_units.text: On that day they will say, “Behold, our God, in whom we hoped and exulted; and we will rejoice in our salvation.”
source_units.display_text: On that day they will say, “Behold, our God, in whom we hoped and exulted; and we will rejoice in our salvation.”

source_units.text: For God will give rest upon this mountain, and Moab’s land will be trampled as people tread a threshing floor with wagons,
source_units.display_text: For God will give rest upon this mountain, and Moab’s land will be trampled as people tread a threshing floor with wagons,

source_units.text: and he will release his hands, just as he himself brought low for destruction; he will bring low his insolence over what he laid his hands on,
source_units.display_text: and he will release his hands, just as he himself brought low for destruction; he will bring low his insolence over what he laid his hands on,

source_units.text: and he will bring low the height of your wall’s refuge, and it will descend to the ground.
source_units.display_text: and he will bring low the height of your wall’s refuge, and it will descend to the ground.

source_units.text: On that day they will sing this song in Judah’s land, saying, “Behold, a fortified city! He will make our salvation a wall and an encircling wall.
source_units.display_text: On that day they will sing this song in Judah’s land, saying, “Behold, a fortified city! He will make our salvation a wall and an encircling wall.

source_units.text: Open the gates; let a people enter, keeping righteousness and keeping truth,
source_units.display_text: Open the gates; let a people enter, keeping righteousness and keeping truth,

source_units.text: holding fast to truth and keeping peace. For in Thee
source_units.display_text: holding fast to truth and keeping peace. For in Thee

source_units.text: they hoped, Lord, for ever, the great, everlasting God,
source_units.display_text: they hoped, Lord, for ever, the great, everlasting God,

source_units.text: Thou who didst humble and bring down those dwelling on high. Thou wilt cast down fortified cities and bring them to the ground,
source_units.display_text: Thou who didst humble and bring down those dwelling on high. Thou wilt cast down fortified cities and bring them to the ground,

source_units.text: and the feet of the meek and lowly will trample them.
source_units.display_text: and the feet of the meek and lowly will trample them.

source_units.text: The way of the devout became straight, and the way of the devout is prepared.
source_units.display_text: The way of the devout became straight, and the way of the devout is prepared.

source_units.text: For the Lord’s way is judgment. We hoped in Thy name and in the remembrance
source_units.display_text: For the Lord’s way is judgment. We hoped in Thy name and in the remembrance

source_units.text: which our soul desires. From night my spirit rises early toward Thee, God, because Thine ordinances are light upon the earth. Learn righteousness, you dwelling upon the earth!
source_units.display_text: which our soul desires. From night my spirit rises early toward Thee, God, because Thine ordinances are light upon the earth. Learn righteousness, you dwelling upon the earth!

source_units.text: For the ungodly has ceased; he will certainly not learn righteousness upon the earth or practice truth. Let the ungodly be removed, so that he may not see the Lord’s glory.
source_units.display_text: For the ungodly has ceased; he will certainly not learn righteousness upon the earth or practice truth. Let the ungodly be removed, so that he may not see the Lord’s glory.

source_units.text: Lord, Thine arm is high, and they did not know; when they know, they will be ashamed. Zeal will seize an undisciplined people, and now fire will consume the opponents.
source_units.display_text: Lord, Thine arm is high, and they did not know; when they know, they will be ashamed. Zeal will seize an undisciplined people, and now fire will consume the opponents.

source_units.text: Lord our God, give us peace, for Thou hast repaid everything to us.
source_units.display_text: Lord our God, give us peace, for Thou hast repaid everything to us.

source_units.text: Lord our God, acquire us! Lord, we know no other besides Thee; we name Thy name.
source_units.display_text: Lord our God, acquire us! Lord, we know no other besides Thee; we name Thy name.

source_units.text: The dead will certainly not see life, nor will physicians ever raise them. Therefore Thou didst bring calamity, destroy and remove every male of theirs.
source_units.display_text: The dead will certainly not see life, nor will physicians ever raise them. Therefore Thou didst bring calamity, destroy and remove every male of theirs.

source_units.text: Add evils to them, Lord; add evils to all the earth’s glorious people!
source_units.display_text: Add evils to them, Lord; add evils to all the earth’s glorious people!

source_units.text: Lord, in affliction I remembered Thee; in slight affliction Thy discipline was for us.
source_units.display_text: Lord, in affliction I remembered Thee; in slight affliction Thy discipline was for us.

source_units.text: Like a woman in labor nearing childbirth and crying out in her pang, so we became toward Thy beloved because of fear of Thee, Lord.
source_units.display_text: Like a woman in labor nearing childbirth and crying out in her pang, so we became toward Thy beloved because of fear of Thee, Lord.

source_units.text: We conceived, labored and gave birth; we produced the spirit of Thy salvation upon the earth, but those dwelling upon the earth will fall.
source_units.display_text: We conceived, labored and gave birth; we produced the spirit of Thy salvation upon the earth, but those dwelling upon the earth will fall.

source_units.text: The dead will rise, those in the tombs will be awakened, and those in the earth will rejoice, for the dew from Thee is healing to them; but the earth of the ungodly will fall.”
source_units.display_text: The dead will rise, those in the tombs will be awakened, and those in the earth will rejoice, for the dew from Thee is healing to them; but the earth of the ungodly will fall.”

source_units.text: Go, My people, enter your inner rooms, shut your door, hide for a little, a very little while, until the Lord’s wrath passes.
source_units.display_text: Go, My people, enter your inner rooms, shut your door, hide for a little, a very little while, until the Lord’s wrath passes.

source_units.text: For behold, the Lord brings wrath from the holy place upon those dwelling on the earth. The earth will uncover its blood and will not cover those killed.
source_units.display_text: For behold, the Lord brings wrath from the holy place upon those dwelling on the earth. The earth will uncover its blood and will not cover those killed.

source_units.text: On that day God will bring the holy, great and strong sword against the dragon, the fleeing serpent, against the dragon, the crooked serpent, and will kill the dragon.
source_units.display_text: On that day God will bring the holy, great and strong sword against the dragon, the fleeing serpent, against the dragon, the crooked serpent, and will kill the dragon.

source_units.text: On that day, a beautiful vineyard; a desire to lead a song against her.
source_units.display_text: On that day, a beautiful vineyard; a desire to lead a song against her.

source_units.text: “I am a strong city, a besieged city; in vain I will water her, for she will be captured by night, and by day the wall will fall.
source_units.display_text: “I am a strong city, a besieged city; in vain I will water her, for she will be captured by night, and by day the wall will fall.

source_units.text: There is none who has not seized her. Who will set me to guard stubble in a field? Because of this hostility I rejected her.” Therefore, for this reason the Lord God has done everything He commanded. “I have been burned!”
source_units.display_text: There is none who has not seized her. Who will set me to guard stubble in a field? Because of this hostility I rejected her.” Therefore, for this reason the Lord God has done everything He commanded. “I have been burned!”

source_units.text: the residents in her will cry. “Let us make peace with Him; let us make peace.”
source_units.display_text: the residents in her will cry. “Let us make peace with Him; let us make peace.”

source_units.text: Those coming, Jacob’s children—Israel will sprout and flower, and the inhabited world will be filled with his fruit.
source_units.display_text: Those coming, Jacob’s children—Israel will sprout and flower, and the inhabited world will be filled with his fruit.

source_units.text: Surely he will not be struck just as he himself struck, and be killed just as he himself killed?
source_units.display_text: Surely he will not be struck just as he himself struck, and be killed just as he himself killed?

source_units.text: Fighting and reproaching, he will send them away. Wast Thou not the One planning with a harsh spirit to destroy them with a spirit of wrath?
source_units.display_text: Fighting and reproaching, he will send them away. Wast Thou not the One planning with a harsh spirit to destroy them with a spirit of wrath?

source_units.text: Therefore Jacob’s lawlessness will be removed, and this is his blessing: when I remove his sin, when they make all altar stones cut down like fine dust. Their trees will certainly not remain, and their idols will be cut down like a forest far away.
source_units.display_text: Therefore Jacob’s lawlessness will be removed, and this is his blessing: when I remove his sin, when they make all altar stones cut down like fine dust. Their trees will certainly not remain, and their idols will be cut down like a forest far away.

source_units.text: The inhabited flock will be released like an abandoned flock; it will be pasture for a long time, and there they will rest.
source_units.display_text: The inhabited flock will be released like an abandoned flock; it will be pasture for a long time, and there they will rest.

source_units.text: After a time there will be nothing green in her because it has dried. Women coming from a spectacle, come! For this is a people without understanding; therefore their Maker will certainly not pity them, nor will the One who formed them ever have mercy.
source_units.display_text: After a time there will be nothing green in her because it has dried. Women coming from a spectacle, come! For this is a people without understanding; therefore their Maker will certainly not pity them, nor will the One who formed them ever have mercy.

source_units.text: On that day the Lord will fence off from the River’s canal to Rhinocorura; but you, gather Israel’s sons one by one.
source_units.display_text: On that day the Lord will fence off from the River’s canal to Rhinocorura; but you, gather Israel’s sons one by one.

source_units.text: On that day they will sound the great trumpet. Those lost in the Assyrians’ country and those lost in Egypt will come and bow to the Lord upon the holy mountain in Jerusalem.
source_units.display_text: On that day they will sound the great trumpet. Those lost in the Assyrians’ country and those lost in Egypt will come and bow to the Lord upon the holy mountain in Jerusalem.
